utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tess, I’ve already got screws covered, but we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s good to know—I’ll pass along that screws are covered, and now we’re still short on duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Tess—please let folks know duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves are still needed, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal—that’s encouraging to hear. I’m still out on errands, but keep me posted if the repair drive needs anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’m keeping track of who’s covered, and Maple already has 12, 18, and 27 on the list. If anything else comes up for the repair drive, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds solid, thanks for staying on top of it. I’m still out for a bit, but keep me posted if any gaps show up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, can you confirm who actually signed up and whether Raj or Elena definitely committed tools, instead of us working off guesses?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet—I only have second-hand bits, so I don’t want to guess. I can check the sign-up list today and ask Raj and Elena directly what tools they’re actually bringing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please do that today and send me the actual names, volunteer count, and exactly what Raj and Elena confirmed they’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know a little so far, but I heard the porch steps on Maple should come first. If you want, I can help make a simple list so folks know what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d help a lot, Rey — if you make a simple list, I’ll match it with what I can bring from my toolbox and spare clamps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, I can do that—let’s start with the porch steps on Maple, then the garden lot fence after. If you tell me what you’ve got on hand, I’ll keep the list simple.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Uli, I’m spreading the word fast for the repair drive—can I count you in, and should I let the rest of your side of the block know too?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can bring a few tools by later, and you can let them know I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll let your side of the block know you’re bringing tools and pitching in later, and I’ll keep the invites moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 works for me as long as we start right on time and keep it fairly tight, since I need to be free for school pickup later.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That suits me fine—Saturday at 10 by the community center, and we’ll keep to the list: porch steps on Maple first, then the garden lot fence.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Saturday at 10 by the community center works for me. I’ll come right after drop-off so we can get started promptly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right—tables are mine, and I still don’t think anyone’s claimed the lamp rewiring yet. I’m sorry, Sam, I’m blanking on anything else unassigned besides that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries—I'll take the lamp rewiring, and I can ask around the block in case anything else still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s a relief—thanks, Sam. And I still need to bring those spare screws over for Uli; I nearly forgot again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I lock anything in for the repair drive, can you confirm the current sign-up count and which houses still need fixes?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have the count in front of me, and I’d rather not guess — can we get the latest sign-up list and the houses needing fixes from the organizers, along with the drop-off window and setup plan?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, let’s get the latest sign-up list and repair list from the organizers first, and can you also ask them to confirm the drop-off window and whether tool intake or setup still needs covering?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m just getting here, Bo—can you catch me up on which houses still need fixes and whether we’ve got enough nails and spare boards?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still waiting on Rosa’s list, so I don’t have the house-by-house fixes yet. I’ve got a drill, extension cord, and spare screws covered, but you should check with Gus on nails and boards.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll check with Gus on the nails and boards, and once Rosa’s list comes through, just point me at the first house that still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m thinking around 10 still, if that works for the repair drive—and I think duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 10 works for me, Noah—I’ll pass along the start time and let folks know we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good—thanks, Jules. And yeah, I think Cleo said screws are already covered, unless I’m mixing that up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still in for the repair drive—do you want me to start by lining up volunteers and repair items to send over to Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes—please line up volunteers and a repair list for Rosa. Fence by the alley should be first priority.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll ask around this afternoon, put the alley fence at the top of the repair list, and send Rosa the volunteers and items I gather.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Rosa, can you confirm who’s actually committed for the repair drive and whether the tools are definitely lined up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m still firming that up, Kira — Bo’s committed to review the list for tools and repair needs, and Mara’s gathering more items and volunteer names this afternoon. I can confirm the full committed list once those updates come in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but that’s not really confirmed yet, is it? Let me know once Bo and Mara have both said directly what’s covered and who’s actually committed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sam, the repair drive’s coming together, and I’m letting people know we’ve got tools and extra hands lined up. I’m also spreading the word that we could really use folks who know bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great to hear—I’m happy to help and I can spread the word around the block too. Do you want me to focus on finding more bike and small-appliance folks first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that’d be a big help—please focus on folks who know bikes or small appliances first, since that’s where we could use the most support.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Eli, I’ve already got screws covered, but we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That helps—let’s add duct tape and two pairs of work gloves to the list, then check what else is still missing before we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’ve marked duct tape and two pairs of work gloves as still needed, and I can read off the rest of the list so we know what to ask for.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, let’s do 10 on the dot then—that should keep it tidy before your pickup, and I can slide a little if we need to.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works great for me—10 on the dot is perfect, and I’ll plan the school run around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, 10 it is then—thanks, Faye. I’ll try to have things pulled together before you get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I answer, can you confirm the latest confirmed sign-up count for the repair drive and whether the Patel house is already marked finished?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don’t have the latest count, sorry, and I’m not sure about the Patel house either. Tess would know better than me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, thanks for being honest—let’s check with Tess first so we have the confirmed sign-up count and know whether the Patel house is already finished.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, the repair drive’s coming together—I’ve got a few neighbors lined up to bring tools and extra hands. We should also lock in who’s dropping off what and set a firm drop-off window so it stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m coming in late—what’s the first thing that still needs a hand, and who still needs a drop-off slot locked in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: First thing is pinning down the tool list and drop-off window, and I’m still matching neighbors to slots now—if you can help track who’s bringing what, that’d take a load off.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mina—I'm still out on errands, but the repair drive’s coming together, so keep me posted if you hear who else is in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, before I can keep you posted, what’s actually still open right now—who’s taking the lamp rewiring, and what jobs still don’t have an owner?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking in while I’m out, but lamp rewiring doesn’t have a firm owner yet and a couple of pickup and sorting slots are still open. If you hear anyone who can take one of those, let me know and I’ll fold them in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please check with the organizers this afternoon—I’d like to know the setup spots and a clear drop-off window before the day gets too busy.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’ll check with Rosa and the others this afternoon and get you the setup spots plus a clear drop-off window as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal—that makes me feel a lot better. Once you hear back, let’s make sure Rey knows where to go and who to check in with so they’re not left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before we get too far, can you confirm who’s definitely got tools covered and which volunteers are actually committed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can’t confirm that for sure yet—I only heard second-hand that a few people signed up, and I think Raj and maybe Elena were bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, then I’m still not comfortable calling that settled—can you check with Sam or Tess and confirm exactly who’s bringing tools and who’s actually committed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Bo, I’m still pinning down the direct confirmations—Uli said they can bring a few tools later, and Gus is waiting on the full list before bringing his drill and screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—send me the list when it lands and I’ll skim for who’s bringing tools and who needs fixes. For now, mark me down to help sort the sign-up fast.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that helps a ton, Bo—I’ll mark you down for sign-up sorting and send the list your way the minute it lands so we can keep the tools and fixes straight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, we’ve got the repair drive coming together—can you join in, and if you’re up for it, help spread the word too?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep—I can do an hour this weekend and help spread the word. What still needs covering most: tool intake, pickups, or drop-off coordination?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Leo—drop-off coordination still needs the most coverage, and if you can also help spread the word, that’d really keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — that helps a lot. I’m finishing the list now, so just send over whatever you hear this afternoon and I’ll add it in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You got it, Rosa—I’ll check in around the block this afternoon and send you any repair items and volunteer names as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Mara — once I get your update, I’ll fold it into the list and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 works for me as long as we start on time, since I need to keep the school pickup window clear later.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know—10 should be fine from what I’ve heard, but I’m still fuzzy on the repair drive details. I only caught second-hand that they’re collecting money for parts and loaned tools, so we should probably confirm with the organizer.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That makes sense—if you can check with the organizer, I’m still good for 10 as long as we keep it fairly tight around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — I’m pulling together the repair drive details now, so if you’ve heard of any repair needs or neighbors who can volunteer tools, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but let’s make a clear list first and pin down who’s bringing tools, where drop-off is, and a firm drop-off window so nothing gets lost.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a good call, Pia — I’ll draft the list with tool volunteers, repair requests, the drop-off spot, and a clear time window, then send it over for you to review.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I buy into it, can you confirm Marta’s actually got the tools lined up and Ben’s directly confirmed the volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands, so I can’t confirm that firsthand right this second, but keep me posted on what you hear and I’ll follow up as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so we still don’t have it confirmed then—can you check with Marta and Ben directly and let me know once they’ve actually said yes?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s coming together, little by little. If people still want to stop by, we could use steady hands more than anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll keep telling folks the repair drive’s coming together and that what we really need now is more steady hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. That means a lot right now—quiet help like that keeps it going.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help—what still needs doing for the repair drive, and should I start with outreach or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—Mara already pointed me toward tool sorting, so if you can handle outreach first that’d probably help most. What’s the latest on supplies?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take outreach first and spread the word around the block; on supplies, I’m sorting the donated tools and setting aside anything we’re low on, especially screws, duct tape, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Leo, I’ve already got screws covered, but we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can pick up the duct tape and two pairs of gloves. Send me the size if it matters.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be a big help, Leo—medium and large should cover us for the gloves, and I’ll mark duct tape as handled once you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: So far on Maple, 12, 18, and 27 are already on the repair drive list, and I’m covering the rest of Maple plus the corner apartments so we don’t miss anyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—so that’s three confirmed so far; who’s tracking the total sign-ups across all streets, and have you heard who’s actually taking the lamp rewiring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m tracking the overall sign-ups as they come in, and I haven’t heard a firm name for the lamp rewiring yet—I’m still waiting to compare notes once Quinn circles back from Cedar and Pine.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Rey, I’m pretty sure the folding tables are mine, and I still don’t think we had anyone for the lamp rewiring unless that changed while I was being scatterbrained.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t think I heard anyone take the lamp yet, so maybe we should put that clearly on the list. If you want, I can help go through it with you one job at a time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a big help, Rey — I keep losing the thread. So, folding tables are mine, lamp rewiring still needs a volunteer, and I’m supposed to bring Uli those spare screws this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t heard the full parts list yet, Jules, but I’m planning to bring my toolbox and a couple of spare clamps either way.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Gus—your toolbox and clamps will definitely help. I’m putting together a simple shared list and a clear drop-off spot, and I’ll send you the details once I’ve checked in with a few more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Jules — send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll make sure the toolbox and clamps are there Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Late morning still seems right to me—around 10—but I should probably check with Cleo so I don’t miss anything about what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds right to me too—10 works, and once you’ve checked with Cleo, send me what’s still needed so I can help line people up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll check with Cleo and send you the list once she confirms what’s still needed—last I remember it was duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Quinn, the clearest plan I’ve got is to start with the broken porch steps on Maple, then the fence by the garden lot. If we keep a simple list and take one job at a time, it ought to go smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That sounds solid, Eli—I’ll start spreading the word right away and let folks know we’ve got a clear order: Maple steps first, then the garden lot fence.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Quinn. Just tell folks that order for now, and once we confirm the collection list, we can add that without muddying things.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo, can you confirm which houses still need repairs and whether the Patel house is already finished, so we know the current list before assigning tool intake and pickups?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I haven’t got the current house list yet, so I can’t confirm Patel or the rest. Send me the quick list when it lands and I’ll skim it fast for what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—once the list lands, can you check Patel first and flag which houses still need fixes so we can line up tool intake and pickups accurately?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
